title: Heavenly Father Shows His Wonders
traveler_why: Scout is the Traveler who stops to look and ask, and tonight the Lord shows Job the stars, the sea and the snow: Scout stops on a walk to watch a tiny ant carry a crumb ten times its size and wonders how Heavenly Father made something so little so strong.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because Scout loves to notice the wonders of Heavenly Father’s world. In Scout’s world today: on a walk, Scout stopped to watch a tiny ant carry a crumb ten times its size. “Look and see — how did Heavenly Father make something so little so strong?” Scout wondered. Just like Job’s eyes grew big at Heavenly Father’s creations, Scout discovered that the whole world is full of Heavenly Father’s amazing work.
